d:
Microsoft has declared a "Code Red" to overhaul its system reliability after a 24-hour outage on November 12–13 crippled Microsoft 365 services worldwide, disrupted governments, airlines, and trading firms, and forced CEO Satya Nadella to apologise. Blaming an undetected July Windows scalability defect rather than cyberattacks or AI agents, internal memos revealed that the affected component had logged roughly a decade's worth of "acceptable failures"
Thank you for watching our video!
